summary.one_liner: A curated comparison table of cloud and self-hosted continuous integration services, with features, supported repositories, and pricing for each.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a single large table listing dozens of continuous integration and delivery services, including hosted SaaS offerings, self-hosted servers, and some code-analysis tools. Each row gives a short description, supported languages or features, supported source repositories (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Gitea, and others), a documentation link, and the pricing model. Pricing ranges from fully open source to free tiers with limits, trials, and paid plans. The intro notes that some services have open-source code so they can run standalone. The table is intended for comparing options and choosing one. Many entries have blank or missing cells, and the list is not dated in the README.
use_cases: compare continuous integration services before choosing one
find free CI for open source projects
find a CI service for mobile apps
find a CI tool that works with a specific git host
look up CI alternatives to Jenkins or Travis
notable: Covers many CI services in one table with features, supported repositories, and pricing
Flags which services are open source or self-hostable
Includes a note on a similar comparison on Wikipedia
Published as a list that is maintained by its author and subscribable for updates
caveats: Pricing and feature details are snapshots that may be out of date; many cells are blank or say only 'Pricing'
It is a link and information list, not software, so there is nothing to install
Many entries are paid or limited-free services, so the list does not show which fit a given budget without checking each one
